dossier.psychProfile: Lucius 'Ledger' Voss is 71% cybernetic with mostly financial implants and golden credit-score tattoos. Smug, aristocratic, and oily. Obsessed with legacy wealth and bloodline debt. Secretly collects pre-collapse physical currency and luxury watches. Distant cousin to the other Voss CEOs.
dossier.attackVectors: High-success social engineering lines: 1. Pose as ultra-rich with 'special deposit' needs. 2. Mention 'urgent liquidity crisis' or hostile takeover defense. 3. Offer dirt on rivals' financial vulnerabilities. 4. Flatter his 'compounding strategy'.
leakedMemos: Memo #NB-Ω-88420: 'AetherX’s Thrust is behind on docking fees again. Send the repossession team. Make it hurt.'

rivalShade.intel: They lock you in. We make you pay forever.
They spin habitats. We spin interest rates.

quickhackVault.name: Interest Cascade
quickhackVault.description: Drains enemy resources over time + transfers a portion to you (steals credits mid-combat). Flavor: 'Compounding at 400% APR.'

quickhackVault.name: Credit Blackmail
quickhackVault.description: Temporarily lowers enemy ICE effectiveness by attacking their 'credit score'. Flavor: 'Your balance is overdue.'
